title: Feature to Function
blurb: Match each job to the capability that does it.
source: Microsoft AI-901 (Azure AI Fundamentals) skills-measured guide · in-scope Azure AI services
hint: Drag each job onto the capability that performs it. The reveal names the service it belongs to.

items.label: Pull machine-readable text out of a photo of a whiteboard or street sign.
items.why: Azure AI Vision's Read API applies OCR to extract printed and handwritten text from images, unlike Image Analysis's captioning and tagging.

items.label: Identify and place bounding boxes around individual objects in a photo.
items.why: Azure AI Vision's Object Detection returns bounding boxes and labels for individual objects found in an image.

items.label: Generate a natural-language caption describing what's happening in an image.
items.why: Azure AI Vision's Image Analysis captioning feature generates a natural-language description of an image's content.

items.label: Convert a live microphone feed into streaming text in real time.
items.why: Azure AI Speech's speech-to-text recognition transcribes streaming or batch audio into text in real time.

items.label: Produce natural-sounding spoken audio from written text for a voice assistant.
items.why: Azure AI Speech's text-to-speech synthesis converts written text into natural-sounding spoken audio.

items.label: Translate spoken French audio into spoken or written English in real time.
items.why: Azure AI Speech's Speech Translation feature translates spoken audio into another language's text or speech in real time, combining recognition and translation in one call.

items.label: Pull out people, places, organizations, and dates named in a block of text.
items.why: Azure AI Language's Named Entity Recognition identifies and categorizes people, places, organizations, and dates mentioned in text.

items.label: Automatically find and redact credit-card numbers and phone numbers found in support transcripts.
items.why: Azure AI Language's PII detection feature finds and can redact sensitive personal data like phone numbers and card numbers in text.

items.label: Condense a long article down to its most important sentences.
items.why: Azure AI Language's summarization feature condenses long text into its most salient sentences or a short abstract.

items.label: Detect which of dozens of languages a piece of incoming text is written in.
items.why: Azure AI Language's language detection feature identifies which of dozens of languages a piece of text is written in.

items.label: Build a chatbot that recognizes a user's intent, such as 'book a flight,' and pulls out key entities from their message.
items.why: Azure AI Language's Conversational Language Understanding trains a model to recognize a user's intent and extract entities from conversational input.

items.label: Instantly translate a chat message typed in Spanish into German.
items.why: Azure AI Translator's text translation feature converts text between languages in real time via a single API call.

items.label: Translate an entire Word document while preserving its original layout and formatting.
items.why: Azure AI Translator's Document Translation feature translates whole documents asynchronously while preserving their original formatting and layout.

items.label: Extract vendor, total, and line items from a receipt using a ready-made model, with no training required.
items.why: Azure AI Document Intelligence's prebuilt models extract known fields from standard form types like invoices and receipts with no training required.

items.label: Train a model on your own custom form layout that no prebuilt model covers.
items.why: Azure AI Document Intelligence's custom models are trained on your own labeled form layouts that no prebuilt model covers.

items.label: Pull raw text, tables, and selection marks out of a scanned document's structure.
items.why: Azure AI Document Intelligence's Layout model extracts raw text, tables, and selection marks along with a document's structure.

items.label: Pull invoice numbers, totals, and line items out of scanned PDF forms and photographed receipts into structured JSON fields you named yourself.
items.why: Azure Content Understanding's document field extraction applies a custom analyzer schema to PDFs, scanned forms, and images to return the specific structured fields you defined, not just a fixed prebuilt layout.

items.label: Get a call recording transcribed and its sentiment and key talking points summarized, or pull spoken dialogue and on-screen text out of a training video.
items.why: Azure Content Understanding's audio and video analysis transcribes and reasons over call recordings and video content, extracting fields such as speaker sentiment, summaries, and dialogue that don't exist in a static document.

items.label: Train a model to sort your own product photos into categories you define.
items.why: Azure AI Custom Vision's image classification trains a model on your own labeled photos to sort images into categories you define.

items.label: Train a model to locate and draw a box around a specific defect type in your own images.
items.why: Azure AI Custom Vision's object detection trains a model on your own labeled images to locate and box a specific object or defect.

items.label: Find the location of every face present in a group photo.
items.why: Azure AI Face's face detection locates the position of every face present in an image.

items.label: Confirm that two photos show the same specific person.
items.why: Azure AI Face's verification (1:1 matching) confirms whether two face images belong to the same person.

items.label: Search a large gallery of enrolled faces to identify who appears in a new photo.
items.why: Azure AI Face's identification (1:N matching) searches a gallery of enrolled faces to find a match for a new photo.

items.label: Score a chat message for hate, violence, sexual, or self-harm content severity.
items.why: Azure AI Content Safety's text moderation scores text for hate, violence, sexual, and self-harm content severity.

items.label: Detect an attempt to jailbreak a chatbot or hide malicious instructions inside a document a model will read.
items.why: Azure AI Content Safety's Prompt Shields detects jailbreak attempts and indirect prompt injection hidden in content a model will process.

items.label: Flag an uploaded image for graphic or violent visual content.
items.why: Azure AI Content Safety's image moderation scores uploaded images for the same harmful-content categories applied to text.

items.label: Flag an unusual spike in a single sensor's reading over time.
items.why: Azure AI Anomaly Detector's univariate detection flags unexpected spikes or dips in a single time-series stream.

items.label: Detect an unusual combined pattern across dozens of correlated sensor streams at once.
items.why: Azure AI Anomaly Detector's multivariate detection flags anomalous combined patterns across many correlated time-series signals at once.

items.label: Retrieve documents by the closeness of their meaning rather than exact keyword match.
items.why: Azure AI Search's vector search retrieves documents by the closeness of their meaning rather than exact keyword overlap.

items.label: Run an AI enrichment pipeline that extracts entities, key phrases, and image text from raw content before indexing.
items.why: Azure AI Search's skillsets run an AI enrichment pipeline that extracts entities, key phrases, and image text from raw content before it's indexed.

items.label: Re-rank keyword search results using a language model to push the most relevant hits to the top.
items.why: Azure AI Search's semantic ranking reorders keyword search results using a language model to surface the most relevant matches first.

items.label: Identify and label the same person's face wherever they reappear across a video.
items.why: Azure AI Video Indexer's face detection identifies and tracks the same person's face as they reappear across a video.

items.label: Produce a searchable transcript labeled by which speaker said each line.
items.why: Azure AI Video Indexer's transcription feature produces a searchable transcript labeled by which speaker said each line.

items.label: Automatically detect scene and shot boundaries in an uploaded video.
items.why: Azure AI Video Indexer's scene and shot detection automatically marks scene and shot boundaries in an uploaded video.

items.label: Deploy GPT-4o for enterprise chat completions with your own quota and content filters.
items.why: Azure OpenAI Service deploys chat and completion models like GPT-4o as an enterprise resource with your own quota and content filters.

items.label: Generate a set of unique product images from a text description.
items.why: Azure OpenAI Service's DALL-E deployment generates new images from a text description.

items.label: Convert a batch of documents into numeric vectors for similarity search.
items.why: Azure OpenAI Service's embeddings models convert text into numeric vectors for similarity search and retrieval.

items.label: Adapt a base model's tone and style using your own labeled examples.
items.why: Azure OpenAI Service's fine-tuning adapts a deployed model's tone and behavior using your own labeled examples.

items.label: Browse and compare foundation models from multiple providers in one catalog before deploying.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry's model catalog lets you browse and compare foundation models from multiple providers before deploying one.

items.label: Trace, test, and score prompt variants against evaluation datasets before shipping.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry's prompt flow and evaluation tools trace, test, and score prompt variants against datasets before shipping.

items.label: Call into a Foundry project programmatically from Python to manage models and agents.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry's SDK exposes an AIProjectClient so code can connect to a Foundry project and manage models and agents programmatically.

items.label: Let an agent search and cite your own uploaded files when answering a question.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service's file search tool lets an agent search and cite your own uploaded files when answering.

items.label: Let an agent write and run code in a sandbox mid-conversation to solve a data or math problem.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service's code interpreter tool lets an agent write and run code in a sandbox mid-conversation to solve a problem.

items.label: Give an agent the ability to call your own external APIs or functions as part of its reasoning.
items.why: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service's function calling lets an agent invoke your own external APIs or functions as part of its reasoning.

items.label: Automatically try multiple algorithms and hyperparameters to find the best-performing model for your dataset.
items.why: Azure Machine Learning's Automated ML tries multiple algorithms and hyperparameters to find the best-performing model for your dataset.

items.label: Build a training pipeline visually by dragging and connecting modules, with no code required.
items.why: Azure Machine Learning's Designer builds a training pipeline visually by dragging and connecting modules, with no code required.

items.label: Track experiment runs, register models, and manage deployment through a governed MLOps pipeline.
items.why: Azure Machine Learning's pipelines and model registry track experiment runs, register models, and manage governed deployment.
